name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff outer stroke at 80% opacity. This keeps the ring visible against any background while ensuring it doesn’t blend into light colors or disappear on high-contrast displays. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it guarantees keyboard users can always track focus without sacrificing clarity for low-vision users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring with a 1px white stroke risks looking like a double border on some interactive elements, breaking visual simplicity. A 2px ring with a 1px white stroke at 70% opacity maintains clarity without the extra weight. Settle it by testing both on dark and light backgrounds at 100% and 400% zoom—if the 2px version meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in all cases, it wins.

name: Ramp
text:

The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence, but it avoids visual clutter and passes WCAG contrast checks at all zoom levels.
